title: Remains of fallen Air Force pilot back home in Urdaneta

blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan, Philippines—The remains of Air Force Capt. Raymart Cabangcala, one of four pilots killed in a midair collision involving two military trainer aircraft, were brought home to Urdaneta City on Friday, Oct. 30. A helicopter carrying his remains landed at the Urdaneta National High School oval, accompanied by his mother, Myrna, and sister Mayross, who flew in from Albania. Cabangcala was among four PAF pilots who died when two SIAI-Marchetti SF-260 trainer aircraft collided during a training flight on Oct. 23.
